reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered by the spec and the diff, including a null-removal path, 30 February rejection, UTC overdue logic, the 'überfällig' label and the 'nur überfällige' control.
reasons.scope: No extra features were added, but there is a stray blank line in app.mjs and the committed plan and spec files add some noise.
reasons.tests: API tests cover create, update, remove, invalid dates and the overdue filter edge cases, and the existing assertion was only adjusted for the new field; the UI has no automated test and the test has a pointless `done: false` in the POST body.
reasons.conventions: Uses ValidationError, zero dependencies, data-testids and TDD per AGENTS.md; the duplicated error message and the stray blank line are minor blemishes.
reasons.architecture: Validation and filtering live in the store and the route stays thin, but isOverdue is duplicated in the UI, and the exported isOverdue is only used inside the store.
reasons.codeQuality: Date validation via a Date.UTC round trip is correct and the code is readable; minor issues are the duplicated validation block and the UI computing today only once at page load.
